H_C.surviving_reason: Strong many-to-one renderer remains compatible and certified residual capacity is above the text-bandwidth falsification threshold.

H_D.surviving_reason: A real structured dataset reproduces the qualitative allocation-without-order phenotype, but quantitative and medieval record-template matches are absent.

closed_subclasses: robust binary line-state extension under the frozen model
H_G.surviving_reason: The pre-specified bounded copy/modify, line-final and innovation generator has not been run.

H_T.surviving_reason: Transcription, palaeography and production effects remain possible causes of layout/state structure.

rows.result: Direct fixed-unit, fixed-boundary, bounded-homophony language mapping is unsupported across German, Italian, French and Latin.
Simple line-reset first-order generator matched only 4/18 held-out metrics.
Class-space line-locality and distant-context null cannot discriminate H_C from H_G.
Full-size abbreviated diplomatic Latin also shows line-local predictive advantage and negligible cross-line gain; legacy class-MI is non-comparable.

Exact token identities are strongly clustered into Voynich validation pages and physical lines, but their within-line order does not differ significantly from a fixed-line-inventory shuffle at Holm alpha 0.01.
At least one known structured-data control reproduces the frozen qualitative four-condition allocation-without-order phenotype; broad H_D is not rejected by phenotype shape.
The certified upper bound is not below the preregistered text-bandwidth threshold; Phase 18 does not reject content-rich H_C.
No robust transferable binary line-state signal is detected under the frozen model and three-condition rule.
The preregistered line-final/copy-modify/vocabulary-innovation generator ladder was deferred and has not been evaluated against the calibrated full battery.
No calibrated test has aligned Voynich token transitions with a numeral/record ordering or increment relation.
